brief:
The health sector in Gaza confronts fundamental challenges more than a year after a ceasefire agreement signed on October 10, 2025, Shehab Wire reported. The agreement, intended to end hostilities, has not reversed the deterioration of medical services across the territory.

The crisis reflects the scale of damage to healthcare infrastructure sustained during the preceding conflict and the obstacles to reconstruction that have persisted in the aftermath.

title: Gaza's healthcare system faces collapse one year after ceasefire
